download_file_group: download a group of large files like odac or oc from the S3 bucket to the fairchem install directory
download_all_files: download all large files across all file groups by passing ALL as the file_group argument
change_path_for_pypi: modify file download paths to work with PyPi-installed fairchem builds instead of git repo builds
fairchem_root: get the root directory path of the installed fairchem-core package as a Path object
parse_args: parse command line arguments to select which file group to download from available choices
